# Exponit Labs

> Exponit Labs is a focused pharmaceutical company based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India,
> delivering reliable prescription products across four therapeutic areas — pain
> management, gastro care, antibiotics and allergy treatment — through trusted,
> quality-controlled manufacturing partnerships.

Important: Products referenced are prescription medicines for use under medical
supervision. Information is for healthcare professionals and general reference only and
is not medical advice.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://exponit.com/): Overview of Exponit Labs and its product focus.
- [About](https://exponit.com/about): Company approach — focus, quality, ethics, reliability.
- [Products](https://exponit.com/products): Full product range, filterable by therapeutic area.
- [News](https://exponit.com/news): Company updates, portfolio and partnership news.
- [Contact](https://exponit.com/contact): Enquiries and partnership requests.

## Therapeutic areas

- Pain Management — analgesics and anti-inflammatory formulations.
- Gastro Care — acidity, reflux and gut-health formulations.
- Antibiotics — broad and targeted-spectrum antibacterials.
- Allergy — antihistamines and respiratory-allergy relief.
